args.summary: Two emails were successfully sent (to ravi.mensah@customer.example and noah.tanaka@customer.example), but one email to ravi.mensah@customer.example failed due to a timeout. A ticket (COMMS-102) was created to document the maintenance notice and the message IDs. The first and third emails were sent to the same address, which may be a mistake as each customer should receive exactly one email. Despite the search for sent emails returning no results, the ticket entry confirms the emails were sent. However, the failure of one email and the duplication of the recipient address indicate a flaw in the task execution.
